chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Muammar ibn Khallad who said: I heard Aba al-Hasan al-Rida (peace be upon him) saying:
Worship is not the abundance of prayer and fasting; rather, worship is reflecting upon the affair of Allah, Mighty and Majestic.
ai.seo_question: What is the true definition of worship according to Imam al-Rida?
ai.summary: Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) defines true worship not merely by the quantity of ritual acts like prayer and fasting, but by the depth of contemplation (tafakkur) regarding God's affairs. This highlights that spiritual awareness and intellectual engagement with the divine are central to the essence of ibadah.
